round_1_findings.evidence: finalizeApp now subscribes first, fires the trigger in a synchronous act, then awaits the promise in a separate async act, which is the R-6 shape. onFinalized starts finalization only through promise continuations, and the helper has no await before the async act opens, so that work runs inside the act scope. Suite: 6 of 6 selected cases pass, 173 of 173 overall, 0 act warnings, so the three cascade failures cleared too.

round_1_findings.evidence: 'ends the tolerance when finalization fails' reaches the path through a rejected authorize. The mutation removes the second of exactly two markFinalized() calls, which is prepareSpecializedApp.tsx:777, and the case then fails at its 'No path for' assertion with Array [] while the other 5 pass. The case cannot pass by the session path: there the route would resolve to /target and no error would post.

The new case has no red run on unfixed code. R-3 and R-7 allow this, and the mutation is the direct proof of what it guards. On unfixed code it could only fail at bootstrap, which would say nothing about line 777.

The new case asserts on the bootstrap element without the createApp swap. It proves the marking, not what a user sees after a failed finalization. By reading, the hook update and the swap should land in the same render in production, so the real error should show; no test or run confirms this.
